posts.author: Jyger85
posts.body: Hey, I have a question: Is there a way to make it so that an event can give you the option for seven choices instead of the default six that MZ's event editor provides you? See, I had this idea where, as part of the intro, you're asked which virtue you hold most dear, and then choose which sin has the strongest hold on you. Problem is, there are seven virtues and sins.

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
There are several plugins that can let you add more than 6 choices. I found that as the first hit of a google search:
MZ - Large Choices
The classic Large Choices plugin that I wrote in Ace when it only supported 4 choices, ported to MV when they updated to 6 choices, and now ported to MZ, which still only gives 6 choices!  By default you get up to 6 choices to work with, but with this plugin, you can combine them together to...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
There are more around, in case that does not work for you.

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
I believe you're looking for
Hime_LargeChoices
! Just install it and put two Show Choices in a row and they'll automatically combine into one.
